evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Appeals directly to verification/rehearsal as the condition for genuine operational capability (competence) and reliable safety/resilience (conservation).

mints.name: UnrehearsedCapabilityIsFictitious
mints.title: a capability not rehearsed is a capability we do not actually have
mints.frame: Does the speaker justify process/drills by framing untested safeguards or capabilities as non-existent?
